correction: An earlier draft asserted ~10^5x, carried over from the program document's '~10^6 shots/core-second' for PyMatching. That figure does not describe THIS graph: on a d=5 25-round space-time graph (2742 edges, 600 nodes) decoding costs 18-36 us/shot, not 1 us. which_ratio_to_quote: decode_batch is the production path and gives the larger, fairer ratio; decode_per_shot matches how the certifier is invoked. Both are reported because picking whichever flatters the argument is the whole failure mode.
